title: C08 · Automatic cancellation of unapproved reservations

blocks.content: CR-08 comes from GitHub issue #64. If a teacher has not approved a student's request three hours before the consultation, the system automatically cancels it, releases the slot, and tells the student that the request was not approved in time. This document describes implementation commit a5cf9d99bfa860a31a6cccfc870edc8e4bc6d4c4 on feat/auto-cancel-unapproved-reservations, PR #67; this documentation change is on main.

rows: When startsAt > now + 3 h, the request stays PENDING and its owner can approve it; CONFIRMED, history, and a notification are stored.
When startsAt <= now + 3 h, a pending request becomes CANCELLED; a late approval returns 409 and still commits the cancellation.
One internal RESERVATION_CANCELLED notification includes the slot, teacher, and reason that the request was not approved in time.
The original CREATED event remains, a CANCELLED audit event is added with a NULL system actor, and the reservation stops blocking the slot.
State, audit, and notification are stored atomically; repeated sweeps do not create duplicates.
The UI disables approve/cancel at <= 3 h and the backend rejects manual cancellation with HTTP 409.

blocks.content: Known boundary mismatch: create rejects only starts earlier than now + 3 h, so it accepts exactly three hours. Expiry and approval treat that same boundary as closed; a request created there can be cancelled shortly afterwards. C08 does not change this rule.

rows: Java 21, Spring Boot 4.1.1, PostgreSQL 17, React, TypeScript, and Vite.
PENDING blocked the slot; its owner could approve during the final three hours; automatic cancellation did not exist.
C07 records 37/37 backend tests on 31a22ad (2 Nov 2026); its backend tree matches baseline main@99210f0. That run does not verify the new cutoff scenario.

blocks.content: Persistence tests use isolated PostgreSQL schemas, Flyway, and reads of committed state. Frontend tests use Vitest and Testing Library. Database services were not started during this documentation task; Compose was kept stopped as requested.

blocks.content: ReservationService remains the lifecycle authority; the scheduler only triggers its operation. The in-app notification, history, and state change form one transaction. PR #67 review approval cannot be verified from local commit history and must be added from the PR record.

items: startsAt > now + 3 h: the request remains PENDING and approval is allowed.
startsAt = now + 3 h: the scheduler cancels; late approval commits cancellation and returns 409; manual cancellation returns 409.
Audit: CANCELLED, actor_user_id NULL, original CREATED retained; the student receives one message with the reason.
A failure while writing history or notification restores the database to the original PENDING state.
While the backend is running, polling can add the interval (default 1 s) plus DB operation time; downtime delays cancellation and notification until restart.
Decide whether creation exactly three hours ahead should be rejected or whether the current cutoff mismatch is formally accepted.
Add a dedicated multi-scheduler concurrency test and job-lag monitoring if required by the deployment model.
